build_beam_search: build beam search generation using vLLM's OpenAIServing class with configurable beam width and sampling params
create_error_response: create an OpenAI-compatible error response with a message, error type, and HTTP status code
run_model_check: run model validation to check if a requested model is supported or can be resolved via LoRA
